title: afm serve configuration
description: Schema for ~/.afm/serve.yaml, the allowlist of projects and pipelines that afm serve may start runs from.

projects.description: Directories a run may be started in.

pipelines.description: Pipeline packages a run may be started from.

limits.description: Bounds on concurrent runs started by the host.

max_running.description: Most runs the host keeps running at once.

max_starting.description: Most runs the host lets start at once.

retention.description: When the host releases a finished run's runtime; off by default.

release_after.description: Go duration, for example 24h, after which a finished run is released. Omit to keep runtimes until released explicitly.

id.description: Identifier used in start requests: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

path.description: Absolute path of an existing directory.

source.description: Pipeline source accepted by afm run --pipeline: a local folder or a Git source.

options.description: Absolute path of an existing options file passed as --pipeline-options.
